lines: I ducked very professionally. You did the scarier part, which was nice.
The horn went bwaa and everyone ran. You ran the useful direction.
You ran toward the loud part. That seemed important and extremely bold.
I was under a table, but I heard useful fighting. Yours, probably.
The village is still here, and I am very attached to that outcome.
You made the raiders stop doing raid things near us. Excellent choice.
I did morale from a safe place. You did the dangerous part.
When the horn sounded, you became part of the answer. I liked that.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
